results.evidence: The agent modified the exact right location in mitmproxy/certs.py, retrieving the CA's SubjectKeyIdentifier extension and constructing AuthorityKeyIdentifier using from_issuer_subject_key_identifier, while falling back to from_issuer_public_key upon ExtensionNotFound. The implementation is functionally equivalent to the upstream patch.

### Summary of Changes

1. **[mitmproxy/certs.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/certs.py#L358-L368)** ([`dummy_cert`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/certs.py#L310)):
   - Updated leaf certificate generation to copy the `AuthorityKeyIdentifier` directly from the issuing CA's `SubjectKeyIdentifier` extension using `x509.AuthorityKeyIdentifier.from_issuer_subject_key_identifier(ski.value)`, conforming to RFC 5280 §4.2.1.1 and §4.2.1.2.
   - Preserved a fallback to `x509.AuthorityKeyIdentifier.from_issuer_public_key(cacert.public_key())` in the event that `cacert` does not contain a `SubjectKeyIdentifier` extension (`x509.ExtensionNotFound`).

2. **[test/mitmproxy/test_certs.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/test/mitmproxy/test_certs.py#L172-L226)** ([`TestDummyCert`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/test/mitmproxy/test_certs.py#L143)):
   - Added assertions to `test_with_ca` verifying that the generated leaf certificate's `AuthorityKeyIdentifier.key_identifier` matches the issuing CA certificate's `SubjectKeyIdentifier.digest`.
   - Added unit test `test_custom_ski` validating that a CA with a custom `SubjectKeyIdentifier` passes that exact identifier into the leaf's `AuthorityKeyIdentifier`, and that the fallback functions properly when no SKI is present on the CA.
